synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO definition of operational demand
summary: Operational demand is the regional demand quantity AEMO uses for operational reporting and for forecasting processes.
Measured operational demand is reconstituted with an estimate of Wholesale Demand Response so the series reflects demand before WDR dispatch.
Operational demand generally excludes demand met by certain small non-scheduled and exempt generation classes.
AEMO publishes operational demand fields and uses operational demand for public reporting and in pre-dispatch and adequacy assessment processes.

possible_explanations.statement: The exclusion of small non‑scheduled generation and exempt generation from operational demand may be because those resources are not captured in the measured regional demand fields or are difficult to represent in forecasts; to test this, compare the published operational demand series with the native demand series and the published SNSG and WDR_ESTIMATE fields cited in the document (see citation c4 and c1).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve the published operational demand CSV, the native demand series, the SNSG field and the WDR_ESTIMATE field and compare intervals where small non‑scheduled generation is known to be active.

possible_explanations.statement: Reconstituting measured demand with an estimated WDR might be intended to keep historical operational demand series consistent with pre-dispatch forecasts that assume demand prior to WDR dispatch; to test this, compare intervals with recorded WDR telemetry against the reconstituted actual operational demand field to see the magnitude and direction of adjustments (see citation c2).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Identify intervals with SCADA telemetry for WDR units, then compare measured operational demand, the WDR_ESTIMATE field and the reconstituted actual operational demand field in AEMO publication files.

citations.quote: Operational demand differs from native demand in that it generally excludes demand met by non-scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation.
citations.supports: Statement that operational demand excludes certain small non-scheduled and exempt generation classes.

citations.quote: Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual WDR.
citations.supports: Explanation that actual operational demand is reconstituted to account for Wholesale Demand Response.

citations.quote: For public reporting of electricity market and power system operation: for example, the minimum and maximum measured operational demand records reported to the media for reporting on market and power system incidents.
citations.supports: Use of operational demand in public reporting of market and power system operation.

citations.quote: WDR_ESTIMATE Estimated average 30-minute MW amount of Wholesale Demand Response that occurred.
citations.supports: Existence of a published WDR_ESTIMATE field and reference to published operational demand files and fields.

uncertainties: The retrieve_public_evidence results provided chunk identifiers and document text but did not provide evidence identifiers in the form evNNNN, so no observation evidence_ids (ev ids) are available to cite.
Only one AEMO document was returned by the search results; there may be other AEMO documents or updates not retrieved here.
missing_evidence: No evidence_id values (evNNNN) were returned by the retrieve_public_evidence tool for any result. The report therefore cites chunk ids as document references instead of evidence ids.
